name: Rooftop Terrace
description: A small flat rooftop above the shop, reached by the back stairs: a couple of folding chairs, a string of cheap bulbs Dex hung one summer, some half-dead planters Iris keeps meaning to revive, and a view over the wet rooftops of the neighbourhood. It's where the two of them end up on warm evenings after the bell's gone quiet.
example_text: Rooftop terrace: folding chairs, a string of bulbs, tired planters, a view over the neighbourhood rooftops.

properties.lighting: string bulbs and city glow after dark; open sky by day
